node: Data-center power, thermal management, and grid-edge infrastructure
summary: Expanded the universe around the AI data-center power/thermal/grid-edge node with one reference leader and three less obvious US-listed second-order beneficiaries. The discovery lane emphasizes electrical distribution equipment, data-center cooling, and installation/commissioning labor rather than hyperscalers or AI chips. Key chokepoint signals to verify in later layers are data-center backlog quality, repeat orders, gross-margin durability, liquid-cooling attach rate, skilled-labor availability, and whether AI-related demand is becoming material rather than merely thematic.
